verdict.rationale: Visa documents a self-serve sandbox sign-up form for merchants (Organization ID, company/contact details, terms acceptance) that immediately unlocks test transactions, and publishes a public TAP reference implementation merchants can adopt to start recognizing/accepting agent traffic. However, production enablement explicitly requires contacting Visa for fees rather than a pure self-serve toggle, and there's no documented online merchant agreement or fully automated endpoint-publishing flow for production. Missing for 10: self-serve production (not just sandbox) enrollment, an online-signable merchant agreement, and independent (non-Visa) confirmation that the sandbox-to-production path is friction-free.
